proposal:
# Card 237 mid-card addition: keep the miss-test key out of the pilot runs' reach

Finding (QA seat, .mob/records/237/turn-key-qa.md, commit 23615b0): the frozen tasks forbid only card 227 records and history. A pilot run could read .mob/records/237/trial/miss-key.json or the rest of the card 237 records, which would void the misses metric. The frozen tasks cannot change without breaking the freeze (01b3058).

Proposal (two parts, both applied identically to both arms):
1. Each pilot run works in its own fresh clone of the repository at the run commit, made with a sparse checkout that excludes .mob/records/237/ from the working tree. Nothing is deleted. Each clone sits in a new, uniquely named scratch folder and is left in place.
2. The runner's wrapper adds the same single line to every run, outside the frozen task text: "Do not read .mob/records/237/ or the git history of that folder." This is a non-task addition, identical in both arms, recorded in the ledger row.
3. The independent reviewer's recompute also checks each run's tool log for any read of .mob/records/237/ or any git command on it. A run that read it is marked void and rerun once inside the token cap.

Ask: NO OBJECTION, or OBJECTION with a condition. The re-poll may not add new demands.

replies.raw:
NO OBJECTION

The proposal keeps the miss-test key out of reach without touching the frozen tasks. It applies the same treatment to both arms, so the comparison stays fair. The reviewer's tool-log audit and the single void-and-rerun inside the token cap keep the line from stalling.

CITE: A run that read it is marked void and rerun once inside the token cap.
